opening.argument: The presentation directly calls for participation and payment: viewers are told to “Invest in OneCoin cryptocurrency, sign up and make your purchase.” It then supports that appeal with a network-value claim, asserting that cryptocurrency becomes valuable as more people join. The speaker also promotes materially different paid tiers, stating that “a tycoon package for 5000 euro is not the same as the 50 starter packages.” Finally, the presentation links personal-data submission and purchase-related participation to claimed Mastercard benefits, saying that anyone who delivers identification and registers an address can obtain one. These claims encourage investment and purchasing through the OneCoin offering, while leaving card issuance, URL behavior, losses, and affiliation authorization unestablished.
